event_summary: A flame at the top of the left red candle flickers while the right red candle remains unlit and still.
raw_event_description: The video shows two upright red taper candles in brass-colored holders on a wooden tabletop against a plain wall. From the first frame through the last, the left candle has a small yellow-orange flame above its wick. The flame changes shape and brightness slightly over time. The right candle has a visible dark wick at its top and no visible flame. The candles, holders, tabletop, and wall show no visible positional change or deformation.

reasons: Both candles and their holders are clearly visible at the start.
The left flame is already present in the first frame.
The right candle top and wick are visible.
